newsitem.title: MEXICO: Nuevo Leon Q2 manufacturing production, sales up.
newsitem.headline: Nuevo Leon Q2 manufacturing production, sales up.

text.p: Manufacturing production in Nuevo Leon state rose four percent and state manufacturing sales climbed 2.7 percent in the second quarter of 1996 compared with the same period last year, according to a private-sector study released Tuesday.

The Manufacturing Industry Chamber (Caintra) said the numbers are a marked improvement from the Q2 1995 figures, which showed production fell by 8.1 percent from the second quarter of 1994 and sales shrank by 10.9 percent from Q2 1994.

The same Caintra survey said employment grew by 3.4 percent in the second quarter of this year compared to the second quarter of 1995. In the second quarter of 1995, employment fell by 2.4 percent from the second quarter of 1994.

"These numbers, although favorable in group form, do not represent signs of recovery for small-sized industries," Caintra, a group of 4,000 companies, said in a document accompanying the figures. "Small-sized industries continue to stagnate."

Production among large industries was running at 66.6 percent of capacity in the second quarter of this year, up from 63.9 percent in the first quarter of 1996. Medium-sized industries operated at 60.5 percent of capacity in Q2 1996, up from 58.5 percent in the first quarter of the year.
But small industries operated at only 48.4 percent of capacity in the second quarter of 1996, virtually unchanged from 48.2 percent in the first quarter of 1996.
